article_title: Xbox Confirms 3,200 Job Cuts and Parts Ways With Double Fine, Compulsion, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs in Sweeping Restructure

content_preview.title: Xbox Confirms 3,200 Job Cuts and Parts Ways With Double Fine, Compulsion, Ninja Theory, and Undead Labs in Sweeping Restructure
content_preview.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma confirmed about 3,200 role cuts through FY27, roughly 1,600 immediately. Double Fine and Compulsion exit as independent studios with their IP, while Ninja Theory and Undead Labs head to new owners.
content_preview.body_excerpt:
## Overview

Microsoft's gaming division has confirmed the contraction it spent late June bracing for. In a memo titled "Resetting Xbox" published July 6 on [Xbox Wire](https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2026/07/06/resetting-xbox/), Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced plans to "reduce our team by approximately 3,200 throughout FY27," including "approximately 1,600 role eliminations today," calling the effort "the most significant restructure" in the platform's history. Four studios — Double Fine Productions...

editor_notes.content_quality: Clean, well-structured News piece (939 words). Overview establishes the July 6 official confirmation, followed by clearly delineated What We Know / Where the Cuts Landed / Studio and Union Reaction / What We Don't Know / Analysis sections. Every claim carries an inline attribution to a specific source.
editor_notes.source_verification: Read all 6 gzipped snapshots (source-0 through source-5, all HTTP 200). source-0 (Xbox Wire 'Resetting Xbox' memo): verified verbatim the '3,200 throughout FY27' figure, 'approximately 1,600 role eliminations today', 'the most significant restructure', 'Our business today is not healthy', 'operating at margins that are 3-10x lower', 'lost 64 cents for every dollar', 'neither possible nor desirable to own every great independent studio', the Compulsion/Double Fine independence line, the Ninja Theory/Undead Labs new-ownership line (State of Decay 3), the Arkane Works Council consultation line, and the 'None of our first party publicly announced games...cancelled' line. Memo is bylined 'Asha'; full name/CEO title corroborated by secondary sources. source-1 (Game Developer): confirmed 3,200, all four studio names, fifth round since 2023 Activision acquisition, 14-layer/max-five management flattening, 50% vendor spend target. source-2 (VGC): confirmed 20% workforce, Arkane as fifth studio, buyers not disclosed pending deal completion, Helen Chiang COO promotion, Bethesda franchise focus (Fallout/Elder Scrolls/Doom/Quake/Wolfenstein). source-3 (VGC): confirmed Compulsion IP (Contrast/We Happy Few/South of Midnight), Compulsion acquired 2018 and Double Fine 'the following year' (2019), and the verbatim Double Fine and Compulsion statements. source-4 (VGC): confirmed Scott Miller/3D Realms 'Most, if not all' id coders claim, 60-70 Obsidian cuts (Kotaku-sourced), Daniel Alpert 21-year departure. source-5 (VGC, dated 30th Jun 2026): confirmed CWA press conference, 'will not be treated as disposable', Frank Arce/District 9, and the demands (advance notice, two years recall rights, hiring freezes).
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: Every number, name, quote, and studio checked against snapshots. No fabrications or misattributions found. The four studio names, the 3,200 figure, and all memo quotes match the sources exactly. The 'June 30 press conference' framing is supported by the union source's own publication date and its description of the CWA event as current.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral and professional. Attributes reporting to outlets rather than asserting; balances Microsoft's rationale with union pushback and the 'reportedly' framing for unconfirmed layoff-scope claims.
editor_notes.originality: Genuine follow-up, not a duplicate. The June 24 article '2026-06/24-xbox-reset-hits-ninja-theory...' covered unconfirmed reports of studio closures and exit talks; this article covers the official July 6 'Resetting Xbox' memo that confirms policy with hard numbers (3,200/1,600), flips the studio outcomes from reported 'closure' to independence/sale-with-IP, and adds leadership changes (Chiang COO, McCarthy retiring) and union reaction. All four internal /article/ cross-references (June 24 reset, Feb 25 Spencer/Sharma, Apr 30 Game Pass, May 18 Double Fine union) exist on main.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: APPROVE. Accurate, well-sourced, neutral News article that verifiably confirms and advances the developing Xbox restructure story. All six source snapshots read and every specific verified; the follow-up framing holds and does not overlap the prior reporting.
